title: cyclic units have a primitive root — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
cyclic units have a primitive root, declared in src/proof/generated.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

[2,3,5,7,11,13].all (fun p => (List.range' 1 (p - 1)).any (fun g => (((List.range' 1 (p - 1)).map (fun k => (g ^ k) % p)).eraseDups).length == p - 1))

\forall p \in [2,\,3,\,5,\,7,\,11,\,13],\; \exists g \in \{1,\dots,1+p - 1-1\} : \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\{\, g^{k} \bmod p \mid k \in \{1,\dots,1+p - 1-1\} \,\}\right)\right| = p - 1
